findings: DEP-012: playwright==1.49.1 is installed with no explicit Chromium library RUN and no playwright install chromium step, because the base IS the install step: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python:v1.49.1-noble ships Chromium and its system libraries at /ms-playwright, and PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH points there. The pip pin and the base tag are the same version, which is what makes the base substitutable for the step.

DEP-015: NOT-APPLICABLE on the compiled-language reading (language = python). On the second reading at the same id, --break-system-packages is present and is required rather than inert: the base is Ubuntu noble, whose system interpreter ships an EXTERNALLY-MANAGED marker. The row's measured case is an official python:* base, which this is not.

DEP-004 / HAL-001: nodejs is justified by 02-TRD's frontend draw, which installs Alpine.js from npm at image build time. build-essential and libpq-dev are kept deliberately: the agent writes the app and chooses its own Python packages, and a source build of psycopg2 or any wheel-less dependency needs both. Recorded under BP-007 rather than trimmed.
CMP-011: no published host port on any sidecar. Trials run concurrently on one host and a published port turns a second trial into a bind conflict.
CMP-019: no restart: key on any sidecar. The harness owns lifecycle and a restart loop hides a boot failure that should surface.
CMP-020: WARN. main carries extra_hosts and ports rather than depends_on alone. C12 in validate_task.py mandates exactly that block and supersedes this row.
